_note: LONG-CONTEXT CHUNKED PREFILL campaign (user 2026-09-27: chunked prefill, 16k/32k per chunk, contexts >= 128k up to 262k, for both MLA and KDA on the SAME shapes). AGENT = Claude Code (Opus 5.5 via Bedrock). ONE KDA decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, cookbook production shape (12 KDA heads/rank, bf16 recurrent state, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 experts, local top-2). Points are prefill chunks (ForwardMode.EXTEND) `B,L,pf<prefix>`: 1 request x L NEW tokens on a <prefix>-token context. Primary: the 16,384-token chunk that completes a 262,144-token prompt (prefix 245,760); secondaries: a 32,768-token chunk completing 262,144 (prefix 229,376), and 16k / 32k chunks at a 131,072-token prefix. For KDA the prefix enters only through the carried-in conv + recurrent state, so the 128k and 256k-context points cost the same; the chunk length is what matters (chunk_kda scan + MoE over 16k/32k rows). Metric = eager step time (sglang does not graph-capture prefill). Correctness = output + post-chunk conv/recurrent state vs a seeded golden from the pristine tree, row-wise prefill rule. Production-fidelity driver flags --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune. GPU mode: slurm (K3_GPU_MODE=slurm). 2026-09-27: oracle re-baked for the long-context points (port 8807); rounds 1-3 used the <=48k-prefix prefill oracle.

render.METRIC: eager chunked-prefill step latency of one Kimi-K3 KDA decoder layer on long-context prompts
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one KDA (linear-attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, 112 local mxfp4 experts, bf16 recurrent state)
render.WORKLOAD: long-context chunked prefill (ForwardMode.EXTEND), one chunk per step, 1 request: a 16,384-token chunk that completes a 262,144-token prompt (primary; prefix 245,760 tokens already processed, their conv + recurrent state carried in; the routed MXFP4 MoE sees ~32k local rows and KDA runs the chunked scan chunk_kda), plus a 32,768-token chunk completing 262,144 (prefix 229,376; ~64k local MoE rows), and 16k and 32k chunks at a 131,072-token prefix (must not regress). For this layer the prefix only enters through the carried-in state, so the chunk length, not the context length, sets the cost.
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /workspace/opt_run && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,2048,pf --attn-type kda --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attn-heads 12 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --experts 112 --ep 8 --local-topk 2 --hidden-scale 1.0 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
